---
name: 🙋 Customization Help
about: Ask questions about how to customize this website template for your cafe
title: '[HELP] '
labels: 'question, customization'
assignees: ''
---

**What are you trying to customize?**
Describe the modification you'd like to make to the Carnival Cafe template (e.g. adding a new section, integration of database, swapping fonts, changing images).

**Where are you stuck?**
Provide details on what you've tried and what isn't working as expected. Include code snippets or terminal errors if possible.

**Screenshots**
If it's a visual styling issue, please upload a screenshot comparing what it currently looks like versus what you're trying to achieve.

**Any relevant configuration details**
Specify if you've modified `tailwind.config.js`, `index.css`, or other main components.
